families.axis: a wrong opinion recorded → conduct deserving severe censure
families._definition: contrary to conscience or morality or law

members.tone: The family's flat verdict, condemning without heat and reaching conscience, morality and law with the same single word.
members._gloss: contrary to conscience or morality or law

members.tone: States the desert rather than colouring it - the thing has earned rebuke, and the word says so and stops.
members._gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

members.tone: Puts the weight of a legal charge behind a censure that is moral rather than legal, which makes it an outcry where *condemnable* is a ruling.
members._gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

members.tone: Voices the disapproval as dismay - the thing is bad enough to be lamented, not merely bad enough to be rebuked.
members._gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

members.tone: Formal and judicial in weight, handing the blame down as a finding rather than an outburst - the cold end of *criminal*.
members._gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

members.tone: Puts the fault in the thing itself rather than in the verdict on it, imputing wickedness where *reprehensible* only assigns blame.
members._gloss: bringing or deserving severe rebuke or censure

members.tone: Contemptuous - it ranks the character as low, not merely at fault, where *immoral* records the failure and leaves the person's standing alone.
members._gloss: not adhering to ethical or moral principles

members.tone: The flat categorical charge: measured against a standard and found outside it, with the force sitting in the standard rather than in the tone.
members._gloss: not adhering to ethical or moral principles

members.tone: Faults the judgment while leaving the intention unblamed - being led wrong is a softer charge than being wrong.
members._gloss: wrong in e.g. opinion or judgment

members.tone: Records the error and nothing else, no reproach attaching, where *misguided* still suggests the opinion was badly arrived at.
members._gloss: wrong in e.g. opinion or judgment

families.axis: plainly made rather than natural → so made it has no substance behind it
families._definition: contrived by art rather than nature

members.tone: The family's flat baseline: it says a thing was contrived rather than grown and stops there, where *unreal* goes on to deny it.
members._gloss: contrived by art rather than nature

members.tone: Sets the made thing against the natural one, so what it withholds is naturalness rather than existence.
members._gloss: contrived by art rather than nature

members.tone: Names the deliberation and no more — the effect was composed, which is a fact before it is a complaint.
Makes that arrangement a performance put on for an onlooker, so what looked spontaneous reads as put-up — the accusation *arranged* stops short of.
Strictly technical — it reports function augmented or replaced by machinery and carries none of the deficiency the rest of the family hangs on the made.
members._gloss: having particular physiological functions augmented or replaced by electronic or electrome

members.tone: Colour got by stripping rather than adding, and the word keeps the drained, washed-out feel of that.
members._gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural

members.tone: The blankest of these — the colour was put there, with no hint of how or how deep.
members._gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural

members.tone: The British spelling, identical in force to *colored*: applied colour, stated without comment.
members._gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural

members.tone: Puts the colour in deep rather than on the surface, more concrete than *colored* and no harsher for it.
members._gloss: (used of color) artificially produced; not natural

members.tone: Withering — the thing is flat, propped up, and has nothing behind it.
A plain report of the shortfall, measuring the thing against life and finding it thin, with none of *cardboard*'s contempt.
Gives the thing the sheen of a screen image and the same nothing behind the surface.
members._gloss: artificial as if portrayed in a film

members.tone: Manufactured-feeling rather than lived — the same screen-thin unreality as *celluloid*, without the sheen.
members._gloss: artificial as if portrayed in a film

members.tone: Says the form was settled by convention rather than felt in the moment — cool and analytic, a shortfall of spontaneity rather than of substance.
members._gloss: using artistic forms and conventions to create effects; not natural or spontaneous

members.tone: The British spelling, carrying exactly the measured, analytic weight of *conventionalized*.
members._gloss: using artistic forms and conventions to create effects; not natural or spontaneous

members.tone: The one here that can name a deliberate artistic manner rather than a failure, where *unlifelike* is only a falling short.
members._gloss: using artistic forms and conventions to create effects; not natural or spontaneous

families.axis: bare shortfall from perfect → a fault that spoils and discredits the thing
families._definition: not perfect; defective or inadequate

members.tone: The plain word for falling short of perfect - it states the shortfall and stops there, without *defective*'s implication that something inside has gone wrong.
Puts the fault on the surface - a mark on something otherwise sound, where *flawed* lets the fault run through it.
The same defect read as structural rather than a spot, which is why it lands harder than *blemished*.
Grades speech or writing as falling short of fluent - a shortfall in the language itself, not *defective*'s fault built into a thing.
Says errors and alterations have got in, so the thing can no longer be trusted as it stands - heavier than *flawed*, which admits a fault without unsettling the whole.
The participle points back at a sound original that errors have since entered, where *corrupt* simply reports the state.
Names the defect as a verdict on the whole item - colder and more final than *faulty*.
Workaday and remediable - it locates a fault to be put right rather than writing the thing off the way *defective* does.
Purely a statement of capacity - it says imperfection could be introduced and passes no judgement, where *defective* and *corrupt* both condemn.
Grades an item as missing the standard of manufacture, registering the imperfection while cushioning it - far short of calling it *defective*.
members._gloss: failing to meet a standard of manufacture due to an imperfection

families.axis: a favorable outcome stated as plain fact → success loud enough to be proclaimed
families._definition: having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome

members.tone: The family's flat statement that the outcome went well, carrying none of the swagger *boffo* brings to the same result.
members._gloss: having succeeded or being marked by a favorable outcome

members.tone: Informal and exuberant - a hit rather than a result, success that arrives with applause attached.
Profit heard as noise, busy enough to be audible, where *flourishing* keeps its liveliness quiet.
Liveliness figured as healthy growth, organic where *booming* is loud.
Ornate and faintly grand, giving profitable liveliness a costume that *thriving* does without.
The participle keeps the gain in motion - still climbing, where *prosperous* names a state already reached.
Settled rather than surging: comfortable profit as a condition, not a rush.
The loudest word in the set - profit at full volume, and it refuses to be understated.
Vitality as the measure of profit, doing well the way a living thing does and with none of *roaring*'s noise.
Swelling growth caught mid-expansion, promising more where *prosperous* implies arrival.
Purely positional - it records that the office is held and passes no judgement on the holding.
Blunt finality: the success is banked and out of doubt, unlike *sure-fire*, which is confident about what has yet to happen.
A technical description of what the pitching allowed, recording the fact where the rest of the family evaluates.
members._gloss: of a game (or the pitching) in which a pitcher allows the opponent no hits

members.tone: Measured, almost accounting approval - results were yielded, with none of *boffo*'s noise about them.
Approval aimed at the person rather than the outcome, crediting the effort behind the success.
members._gloss: having achieved success or recognition by your own efforts

members.tone: Confidence issued in advance, guaranteeing a success that *made* can already report as done.

families.axis: flat statement that something bears or can bear → praise for abundant yield
families._definition: producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly)

members.tone: Plain approval of output that covers both actual yield and the bare capacity for it, where *prolific* insists the yield is already there.
members._gloss: producing or capable of producing (especially abundantly)

members.tone: Technical and classifying: it records that the plant carries catkins and offers no verdict at all on how much it yields.
members._gloss: (of plants) bearing or characterized by aments or catkins

members.tone: Places a plant by the catkins that characterize it, as flatly as *amentiferous* and with as little praise in it.
members._gloss: (of plants) bearing or characterized by aments or catkins

members.tone: A settled favourable verdict on land, but only that it could be farmed well - potential where *rich* asserts the yield itself.
members._gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively

members.tone: States the same promise as *arable* transparently through the act of cultivating, so it reads as an open possibility rather than a standing classification of the land.
members._gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively

members.tone: Heavier and more literal than *cultivable*, claiming no more than that the work of cultivation can be done here.
members._gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively

members.tone: The most physical of the land words, tying the ground's promise to the labour of tilling it where *arable* keeps the judgement abstract.
members._gloss: (of farmland) capable of being farmed productively

members.tone: Elevated praise for a mind that generates abundantly, richer and more admiring than a flat *productive*.
Praises a mind as ground ideas grow from - readiness and promise, where *prolific* counts what has actually come out of it.
Admiration measured by sheer quantity of intellectual output, where *fecund* admires its richness instead.
Coolly appraising rather than approving - it marks an animal as carrying fur worth having, without any compliment to the animal.
members._gloss: of animals having fur (especially of commercial quality)

members.tone: A bare compound naming what the plant puts out, with none of the claim about quantity that *productive* carries.
Says only that oil is present inside - containing rather than yielding, so nothing is being produced here at all.
Short, everyday and emphatic, asserting abundance outright where *productive* still allows mere capacity.

families.axis: unsuited to practical use → derided as senseless
families._definition: not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters

members.tone: The plain term of the family - it states the unworkability and stops there, without the ridicule *crazy* and *half-baked* carry.
members._gloss: not practical; not workable or not given to practical matters

members.tone: Blunt and total - it leaves the notion nothing salvageable, where *impractical* leaves it merely unworkable.
Contemptuous - it casts the unsoundness as thinking abandoned before it was finished, faulting the effort as much as the result.
Flippant - the foolishness is treated as entertaining eccentricity, so it stings less than *crazy* at the same verdict.
Insulting in a way the others are not - it puts the unsoundness down to a mind too soft to hold a firm thought.
Colloquial and flat - it calls the thing senseless outright, with none of the picture-making *half-baked* offers.
A variant spelling of *meshugge* and no gentler for it - the same unadorned charge of senselessness.
The barest of these spellings, and the shortness suits a word that makes no argument, only a verdict.
The extra syllables give it a flourish the shorter spellings lack, but the judgement of senselessness is unchanged.
Another form of the same dismissal - senselessness stated as settled fact, where *quixotic* would at least credit an aim.
Faults the want of practical sense while crediting the ideals behind it, so the disapproval comes out half-admiring.
members._gloss: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic

members.tone: The gentlest of these - the unrealism is charged to an idealizing temperament rather than a defect, and can be said almost fondly.
members._gloss: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic

members.tone: Puts a look of fanaticism on the same unrealism, so where *romantic* indulges it this one warns against it.
members._gloss: not sensible about practical matters; idealistic and unrealistic

members.tone: Carries no verdict at all - it records unsuitability for everyday needs where *impractical* implies a fault.
members._gloss: not related to or suitable for everyday needs or activities

members.tone: Locates the trouble in the handling rather than in anyone's judgement, so a thoroughly sensible thing can still earn it.

families.axis: temporarily out of place → gone for good through waste
families._definition: no longer in your possession or control; unable to be found or recovered

members.tone: The flat, final member - it puts a thing beyond holding and beyond recovery both, naming a deprivation rather than a mishap.
members._gloss: no longer in your possession or control; unable to be found or recovered

members.tone: Gentlest here - the thing is still somewhere, merely not where it was put, so the loss is provisional and faintly self-excusing.
members._gloss: lost temporarily; as especially put in an unaccustomed or forgotten place

members.tone: The same provisional loss as *mislaid* in a flatter, more formal register, faulting the position a thing ended up in rather than the act of setting it down.
members._gloss: lost temporarily; as especially put in an unaccustomed or forgotten place

members.tone: Pure report of absence - it says only that the thing cannot be found, and unlike *lost* leaves recovery open.
The condemning member - what was had was spent to no purpose, and the word insists someone did the spending.
Registers value come to nothing without fixing on a culprit, which is the accusation *squandered* adds.
Of an animal, and it covers both the one with no home and the one that has wandered off, carrying pity and a touch of nuisance at once.
members._gloss: (of an animal) having no home or having wandered away from home

members.tone: Names only the predicament of being unable to find your way - a passing disorientation beside the standing state *stray* describes, with no blame in it.

families.axis: outcome merely left to chance → grave or deliberately aimed danger
families._definition: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm

members.tone: Flat and unarguable - it states that harm can follow and leaves the judging to someone else, where *unsafe* already faults the thing.
members._gloss: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm

members.tone: Measures the thing against a standard of safety it fails, so the danger arrives with a fault attached that *dangerous* leaves off.
members._gloss: involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm

members.tone: The danger sits in the picture rather than in any verdict - a pace fast enough to break a neck, which can sound thrilling as readily as reckless.
Informal and shrugging - the outcome is handed to luck, which is enough to mark the thing as not worth counting on.
members._gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk

members.tone: The bare formation, saying only that an outcome is full of chance, without the wariness *chancy* packs into the same idea.
members._gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk

members.tone: Informal, with a gambler's wince in it - the odds are being felt rather than merely noted.
members._gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk

members.tone: British and dismissive - the thing is not just uncertain but not to be relied on, the most distrustful way of putting the same risk.
members._gloss: of uncertain outcome; especially fraught with risk

members.tone: Aimed at a person rather than a situation - past caution and liable to violence, and the despair behind it does nothing to soften the warning.
members._gloss: (of persons) dangerously reckless or violent as from urgency or despair

members.tone: Formal and classifying - it registers danger as a property to be assessed, cooler than *risky*, which sounds like advice.
Everyday and weighing - it frames the danger as something one might knowingly take on, where *hazardous* only labels it.
Relishes the danger instead of warning against it, giving the same risk a heat that *hazardous* keeps out.
Condemns outright, because here the danger is designed - something is laying a trap, and the word says so.
Formal and dry for something with teeth - it will serve for the act of biting or for the disposition toward it.
Informal, and the image does the work: the danger is a trap someone is caught in rather than a failing of theirs.
members._gloss: caught in a difficult or dangerous situation

members.tone: Heightened and declamatory - it announces danger with a flourish that *perilous* manages without.
Grave and unironic - danger at full weight, more formal than *dangerous* and with none of the hedging in *chancy*.

families.axis: merely unlike → completely opposed
families._definition: unlike in nature or quality or form or degree

members.tone: The bare statement of unlikeness, fixing no degree — it says two things are not the same and stops there.
members._gloss: unlike in nature or quality or form or degree

members.tone: Casts the unlikeness as a matched opposition, two things defined against each other rather than merely unalike as in *different*.
members._gloss: sharply contrasted in character or purpose

members.tone: The fuller and weightier-sounding form beside *antithetic*, carrying the same sense of two things set squarely against each other.
members._gloss: sharply contrasted in character or purpose

members.tone: Turns difference into a made mixture — the variety is arranged, though nothing in it matches.
members._gloss: of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity

members.tone: Spreads the same idea across the kinds themselves, a plural of difference, where *assorted* keeps attention on the mixing.
members._gloss: of many different kinds purposefully arranged but lacking any uniformity

members.tone: Marks unlikeness strong enough to amount to opposition, past the plain difference of *different* but short of the total inversion of *diametric*.
members._gloss: very opposed in nature or character or purpose

members.tone: Makes the difference visible — the unlikeness is what strikes you when the two are set side by side.
Frames that same striking unlikeness as a property a thing has rather than an effect it produces, the more analytic-sounding of the pair with *contrasting*.
Puts the two at opposite ends of a single line, so the difference is total rather than merely sharp as in *contrasting*.
members._gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed

members.tone: The extended form of *diametric*, identical in force and a shade more formal in shape.
members._gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed

members.tone: The plainest way to state complete opposition, where *diametric* and *polar* dress the same total reversal in a figure.
members._gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed

members.tone: Renders the opposition as two extremes with nothing between them, giving the contrast a fixed maximum that *contrary* leaves open-ended.
members._gloss: characterized by opposite extremes; completely opposed

members.tone: Makes the difference a moving apart rather than a settled state, and lets a standard be the thing departed from, where *disparate* simply finds two things unlike.
members._gloss: diverging from another or from a standard

members.tone: Places the unlikeness at the root — a difference of kind rather than of degree, deeper than the surface difference of *different*.
members._gloss: fundamentally different or distinct in quality or kind

members.tone: States the unlikeness as a clean separation of one thing from another, without any of the extremity of *diametric*.
members._gloss: (often followed by ‘from’) not alike; different in nature or quality

members.tone: Puts the same unlikeness in terms of what can be told apart, so the difference is one that survives inspection, where *distinct* just asserts it.
members._gloss: (often followed by ‘from’) not alike; different in nature or quality

families.axis: plain keenness → enthusiasm intense enough to stop being creditable
families._definition: having or showing great excitement and interest

members.tone: The plain term for the state - it reports the excitement and interest without ruling on whether they are deserved, which is exactly what *overenthusiastic* rules on.
members._gloss: having or showing great excitement and interest

members.tone: Enthusiasm with heat in it, steady and burning rather than merely eager, where *warm* only glows.
The mildest way to call enthusiasm strong - felt and unmistakable, but temperate beside *ardent*.
Enthusiasm with appetite in it: the interest is active and reaches for more of what it likes.
members._gloss: marked by active interest and enthusiasm

members.tone: The same active interest as *avid*, hardened into commitment - an edge that can read as admirable drive or as too much of it.
members._gloss: marked by active interest and enthusiasm

members.tone: Informal, and the enthusiasm is put as a loss of one's senses - the overstatement is the compliment.
members._gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with

members.tone: Enthusiasm as sheer unrestrained force, less self-mocking than *crazy* and more like something the enthusiast cannot rein in.
members._gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with

members.tone: Informal and British; it makes the preoccupation faintly comic without actually condemning it.
members._gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with

members.tone: Informal, and the least flattering of the preoccupied words - the enthusiasm has swamped the wits and left the enthusiast looking foolish.
members._gloss: intensely enthusiastic about or preoccupied with

members.tone: Enthusiasm fastened to a cause rather than a taste, so it reads as conviction and not just liking.
members._gloss: marked by ardent or zealous enthusiasm for a cause

members.tone: Carries the same cause-driven fervour as *evangelical* with the weight shifted onto pressing it outward rather than simply holding it.
members._gloss: marked by ardent or zealous enthusiasm for a cause

members.tone: The enthusiasm is on the surface and radiating - warmly, unambiguously approving in a way *zealous* never is.
Informal; enthusiasm welded to dedication and straining to be put to use, keener to act than to weigh.
The one word here that passes judgement: it grants the enthusiasm and marks it as more than the occasion warranted.

families.axis: expected by convention → binding with no escape
families._definition: morally or legally constraining or binding

members.tone: The family's plain statement that something binds, holding the moral and the legal together without saying which one is doing the work.
members._gloss: morally or legally constraining or binding

members.tone: Formal and solemn — the duty is owned and honoured rather than enforced, where *compulsory* has a rule pressing from outside.
Lets the force show: the point is that you are made to, not merely that a rule exists, which is all *required* settles for.
Flat and impersonal — the rule simply states itself, with none of the pressure *compulsory* puts on the person obeying.
The plainest of these: it names the rule's demand and stops, dramatizing neither the force behind it nor the duty in it.
Mannered, and the binding is social only — taste and custom hold it up, with nothing of the rule that stands behind *mandatory*.
members._gloss: required by etiquette or usage or fashion

members.tone: Puts the source in view — an authority has laid this down — where *required* leaves the hand that requires unnamed.
Formal and weighty, fastening the obligation onto whoever it rests upon instead of stating it as a general rule the way *mandatory* does.
Shuts off escape: no exception or excuse gets you out of it, where *compulsory* claims only that a rule stands behind the demand.
Purely positional — it orders things, marking what must be satisfied first, and passes no judgement on the obligation at all.
members._gloss: required as a prior condition or course of study

families.axis: the bare capacity for speech → speech praised for its polish and force
families._definition: expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language

members.tone: Plain approval of clear, easy expression - it credits a speaker with getting the thought out whole, without *eloquent*'s claim on beauty.
members._gloss: expressing yourself easily or characterized by clear expressive language

members.tone: The strongest praise in the family - expression so ready and effective that the manner of it is admired alongside the matter.
A cool compliment: it names the effortlessness of the speaking and stops there, where *eloquent* reaches for admiration.
Praise for speech that runs without a catch in it - flow, where *eloquent* claims power.
Figurative and frankly ornamental - it admires the sound of the speaking, where *articulate* admires only its clarity.
The figure spelled out at full length, praise with a flourish that plain *fluent* never attempts.
Approving of the delivery itself - words that arrive without friction - and plainer in register than *eloquent*.
Purely descriptive and formal: it records the capacity to speak and passes no verdict on how well.
The bare fact of having speech at all, carrying none of the approval that *articulate* does.
Approves speech that fits the occasion and pleases the ear, judging fitness as much as skill, where *fluent* asks only that the words come easily.
members._gloss: speaking or spoken fittingly or pleasingly

families.axis: flat statement that meaning is absent → contemptuous dismissal of a thing as void of it
families._definition: having no meaning or direction or purpose

members.tone: Plain on the surface and bleak underneath, since it withholds direction and purpose along with sense, condemning where *nonmeaningful* only records.
members._gloss: having no meaning or direction or purpose

members.tone: Colourless and technical, it notes the absence and adds no dismay to it, where *meaningless* sounds the loss.
members._gloss: having no meaning or direction or purpose

members.tone: A deflating verdict rather than a scornful one, saying only that nothing of weight is there and leaving the sneer to *vacuous*.
The outward form is intact and the inside is not, so it carries a ring of sham that flat *empty* does not.
The withering member of the three: formal, and it treats the missing force as a fault rather than a fact.
A cool dismissal of what a thing stands for rather than of its size or loudness, drier and less final than *nonsensical*.
Descriptive rather than damning in this sense, stating an absence of thinking capacity without laying blame, where *nonsensical* passes judgement on what was produced.
members._gloss: lacking the thinking capacity characteristic of a conscious being

members.tone: Blunt and unadorned, refusing the thing any intelligible sense without softening the refusal.
The fuller, more formal judgement that nothing can be made of the thing at all, weightier in the mouth than blunt *nonsense*.
The plainest statement in the family, that meaning is simply absent, with none of the scorn *vacuous* or *nonsensical* carry.

families.axis: quietly well-disposed → openly voiced praise
families._definition: encouraging or approving or pleasing

members.tone: The broadest approval here, covering a disposition, a sign or an outcome alike, and unlike *approving* it never requires the approval to be spoken.
The British spelling, carrying exactly the force of *favorable* and adding nothing to it.
The plain word for approval that shows — in a look, a tone or a word — where *favorable* can stay unexpressed.
members._gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval

members.tone: Cooler than *approving*: the praise arrives as endorsement, stated rather than warmly felt.
members._gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval

members.tone: Formal to the point of stiffness — the same praise as *approving* lifted into an official register.
members._gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval

members.tone: A near-twin of *approbative* in force, ceremonious enough that the praise reads as conferred rather than simply shown.
members._gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval

members.tone: Literary and heightened, its praise closer to applause than to the bare assent of *affirmative*.
members._gloss: expressing or manifesting praise or approval

members.tone: The mildest of these — a leaning in someone's favour rather than praise of any kind, so nothing need be expressed as it must with *approving*.

families.axis: partly spoiled but still there → reduced to nothing
families._definition: spoiled or ruined or demolished

members.tone: The elastic member: it stretches from merely spoiled to flattened, so it fixes that ruin happened without fixing how much is left, where *annihilated* leaves nothing to measure.
Absolute where *destroyed* is elastic - it admits no remnant and no degree, and its sweep makes the ruin sound total rather than merely thorough.
Carries a purpose *annihilated* does not: the completeness is somebody's work, and the word frames what it names as a thing that was to be got rid of.
The informal member, and the offhand phrasing makes the same completeness sound quick and easy rather than momentous beside *annihilated*.
Ruin as a slow affliction rather than an event - what it marks is not smashed but stopped, held back from growing or prospering again.
members._gloss: affected by blight; anything that mars or prevents growth or prosperity

members.tone: British in spelling and the milder half of its pair: the good has gone out of the thing, where *blighted* adds that nothing will come of it now.
members._gloss: affected by blight; anything that mars or prevents growth or prosperity

members.tone: Nothingness reached by covering over: the thing is effaced rather than smashed, which makes this the visual member beside the formal *obliterated*.
The bare adjectival form states the finished nothingness flatly, without the backward glance at whatever caused it that *obliterated* keeps.
Formal and cold next to *blotted out*: the participle points back at an act, and what is left is nothing at all rather than something hidden.
Financial ruin in the bluntest available word - a single snap rather than a decline, and it reports the loss without blaming the one it fell on.
The formal word for that same ruin: it names the poverty left behind rather than the break itself, so it sounds like a settled condition where *broken* sounds like a moment.
Reaches from scorched to gone, fixing fire as the cause while leaving open how much survives - which the compounds beside it refuse to leave open.
members._gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire

members.tone: The clipped form, and the shorter shape makes it read as a property the thing now has rather than a report of what happened to it, as *burned* does.
members._gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire

members.tone: The particle puts the fire's passage across the thing: it names what the flames swept and left behind them, not what they consumed.
members._gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire

members.tone: Says the fire went to its end from the inside and left a hollow behind - more final than plain *burned*, and short of gone.
members._gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire

members.tone: The clipped twin of *burned-out*, its tighter shape making the hollowness sound like the thing's condition now rather than the fire's doing.
members._gloss: destroyed or badly damaged by fire

families.axis: unshowy good taste → style that announces itself
families._definition: having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress

members.tone: Plain approval of taste itself - the elegance is credited to the person's own eye rather than to anything they have matched.
members._gloss: having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress

members.tone: Treats the elegance as a standard met rather than a judgement shown, which is what holds it a step below *stylish*.
members._gloss: having elegance or taste or refinement in manners or dress

members.tone: Sleek and assured - it praises elegance that looks effortless, where *smart* praises elegance that looks attended to.
Crisp, unfussy praise for trimness and polish, without the flair *chic* lays claim to.
Approval held slightly at arm's length - the *-ish* keeps it from committing the way *chic* does.
Derisive - the style is a pose being struck, so the word withholds the very compliment *chic* pays.
Warm, informal approval that grants elegance outright, without the cool appraisal running under *chic*.
British, and the admiration is broad and hearty - it takes in the whole impression rather than any fineness of judgement.
Informal and breezy - admiration blurted rather than weighed, lighter on its feet than *classy*.
Playful approval with the flash left in - it enjoys the show that *chic* would find excessive.

families.axis: open to attack in principle → already taking the attack
families._definition: susceptible to attack

members.tone: The family's flat baseline: it registers that an attack could land without saying anything is missing or anyone is at fault.
Formal and analytic, looking from the attacker's side at what can be gone after, where *undefended* only reports what is not there.
members._gloss: not defended or capable of being defended

members.tone: Puts the weight on impossibility - not that defences are absent but that none could be made to hold.
members._gloss: not defended or capable of being defended

members.tone: Bare report of an absence, with no claim that defence was tried or that it could have worked.
members._gloss: not defended or capable of being defended

members.tone: The mildest wording for the same state, naming the gap as a plain fact of position rather than the failure *undefendable* implies.
members._gloss: not defended or capable of being defended

members.tone: The one member whose danger is to standing rather than to body - exposure that invites suspicion and discredit.
members._gloss: vulnerable to danger especially of discredit or suspicion

members.tone: Pitying - the subject is helpless and unsupplied, where *undefended* notes only the absence.
British spelling, identical in force: helplessness rather than the neutral gap *undefended* reports.
A graded status term rather than a verdict, and the severe end of that grading - extinction imminent, not merely likely.
members._gloss: (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction

members.tone: Absolute here: no protection could hold, a harder claim than *undefended*'s report that none is in place.
members._gloss: not able to be protected against attack

members.tone: Treats the exposure as a standing property of the thing's condition, an adverse mark rather than a neutral gap.
The blunt everyday form of the same adverse judgement, stating the danger without locating the weakness as *insecure* does.
Purely a property of the barrier - it says what can be got through, with no suggestion that anything is coming through.
The graded step below *endangered*: likelihood of peril soon rather than peril arrived.
members._gloss: (of flora or fauna) likely in the near future to become endangered

members.tone: Shifts from susceptibility to fact - the blows are landing, and they can be censure as readily as weapons.
members._gloss: subjected to enemy attack or censure

members.tone: The vivid twin of *under attack*, its gunfire image carrying the same double reach over assault and criticism.
members._gloss: subjected to enemy attack or censure

families.axis: attention pleasantly held → attention seized and fixed
families._definition: arousing or holding the attention

members.tone: The flattest word here - it grants that attention is held and says nothing about how hard, which *absorbing* and *riveting* both do.
The hold is inward and quiet, attention drawn in rather than seized as by *gripping*.
members._gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention

members.tone: Stronger than *absorbing*: attention is not merely drawn in but wholly occupied, with nothing left over.
members._gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention

members.tone: The hold works like a spell - attention is charmed into staying rather than pinned there as by *riveting*.
members._gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention

members.tone: Physical in its force - attention is taken hold of rather than invited, where *fascinating* wins it.
members._gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention

members.tone: The most immobilising of these - attention is fixed in place, not merely drawn in as by *absorbing*.
members._gloss: capable of arousing and holding the attention

members.tone: Light approval - it promises agreeable diversion rather than the deep hold *engrossing* claims.
Warm and easy - the praise is for the pleasure given, not for any grip on attention of the kind *gripping* asserts.
The stiffer, more formal shape beside *amusing*, claiming the same pleasure with less warmth in the saying.
Understated praise - the enjoyment is framed as a pleasant turning-aside, milder than *amusing*.
The pull is curiosity rather than pleasure - it promises something not yet given, where *fascinating* holds you with what it shows.
members._gloss: capable of arousing interest or curiosity

members.tone: A threshold rather than a compliment - it measures whether interest clears the bar for reporting, where the rest of the family reports the pull itself.
members._gloss: sufficiently interesting to be reported in a newspaper

families.axis: a shortfall merely counted → a fitness condemned
families._definition: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task

members.tone: The flat general word for falling short of what a task demands, registering the shortfall without turning it on whoever bears it.
members._gloss: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task

members.tone: Weighs what is brought against what the task takes and finds the two mismatched, where *inadequate* names the shortfall as a defect in the thing itself.
members._gloss: lacking the requisite qualities or resources to meet a task

members.tone: Cool and quantitative - a measured shortfall below the amount or degree required, with none of the verdict *wanting* carries.
The plainest of these, naming the missing amount outright and stopping there.
Formal and weighted, as though the amount had been tested against a standard and pronounced short, where *lacking* only reports the gap.
Puts the unmet requirement down to capacity - not that the standard was missed but that it could not be reached.
The harshest here, reading a missed requirement as a verdict on fitness rather than a measurement of it.
The gentlest way of saying the requirement went unmet, setting the demand beside the resource and leaving the failure unassigned where *incompetent* pins it.
Informal, and it carries the strain of working a job with too few hands rather than the bare count.
members._gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.

members.tone: States the shortfall as a plain condition of the staff on hand, neither excusing it nor blaming anyone for it.
members._gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.

members.tone: Measures the people present against the strength the work was meant to have, framing the gap as a post held by too few.
members._gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.

members.tone: The flattest of the four - a headcount below requirement, without the felt pressure of *short-handed*.
members._gloss: inadequate in number of workers or assistants etc.

families.axis: surface smoothness of manner → felt sensitivity toward the person handled
families._definition: using or marked by tact in dealing with sensitive matters or people

members.tone: Credits the handling rather than the feeling - the praise is for skill that kept something sensitive from going wrong.
members._gloss: using or marked by tact in dealing with sensitive matters or people

members.tone: The same praise in a longer, stiffer shape, where *diplomatic* carries it without the extra weight.
members._gloss: using or marked by tact in dealing with sensitive matters or people

members.tone: Approval with calculation audible in it - the courtesy is graceful and also plainly chosen, where *tactful* sounds felt.
members._gloss: smoothly agreeable and courteous with a degree of sophistication

members.tone: The polish is the whole of it - agreeable with so little friction that you start looking for what is underneath.
members._gloss: smoothly agreeable and courteous with a degree of sophistication

members.tone: Puts the sophistication out front so the courtesy reads as elegance, where *smooth* makes it read as technique.
members._gloss: smoothly agreeable and courteous with a degree of sophistication

members.tone: Courtesy sanded down to inoffensiveness - agreeable because nothing is left to catch on.
members._gloss: smoothly agreeable and courteous with a degree of sophistication

members.tone: Warm where *politic* is shrewd - the skill is credited to sensitivity toward the person rather than to judgement about the situation.
members._gloss: showing skill and sensitivity in dealing with people

members.tone: Makes the care visible as extreme gentleness, handling someone as though they might break, where *tactful* keeps the effort out of sight.
members._gloss: showing skill and sensitivity in dealing with people

families.axis: worth noticing → weighty enough to change the world
families._definition: important in effect or meaning

members.tone: A flat measure of weight in effect or meaning, asserting that something counts without saying the counting is welcome.
More insistent than *significant* — it claims the thing matters and should be treated accordingly, not merely that it registers.
Lifts *significant* to a height where the weight itself is the point, grave and admiring at once.
Adds a boundary to the weight: not just great effect but the opening of something new, which *momentous* never requires.
members._gloss: highly significant or important especially bringing about or marking the beginning of a ne

members.tone: The active twin of *epochal* — it credits the thing with making the new beginning rather than merely marking it.
members._gloss: highly significant or important especially bringing about or marking the beginning of a ne

members.tone: Trades gravity for reach — the effect is felt across the whole world, and the word keeps the physical jolt of its image.
members._gloss: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world

members.tone: The same global reach as *earthshaking*, with the world named outright instead of shaken underfoot.
members._gloss: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world

members.tone: The most violent of the three: the world does not shake but breaks, so the significance arrives as rupture.
members._gloss: sufficiently significant to affect the whole world

members.tone: Carries no appraisal at all — it marks only that something rests on or supplies evidence, so it sits outside any scale of weight.
members._gloss: serving as or based on evidence

members.tone: The stiffer, more formal twin of *evidential*, and just as free of praise or blame.
members._gloss: serving as or based on evidence

members.tone: Points downward rather than upward: the effect reaches what a thing is, describing depth of change instead of how much it is admired.
members._gloss: far-reaching and thoroughgoing in effect especially on the nature of something

members.tone: Where *fundamental* is structural this one is grave, reaching the same way into a thing's nature but spoken with awe.
members._gloss: far-reaching and thoroughgoing in effect especially on the nature of something

members.tone: Deliberately unemphatic — it grants real effect and influence while stopping far short of *monumental*.
members._gloss: fairly large or important in effect; influential

members.tone: Makes the significance imposing, something that stands over whatever is beside it, where *noteworthy* only asks you to look.
A modest claim: it asks for attention and promises nothing beyond it.
Stronger than *noteworthy* on the same ground — attention is compelled rather than merely deserved, and admiration comes with it.

families.axis: bare absence of mess → admiring, kept-up order
families._definition: marked by order and cleanliness in appearance or habits

members.tone: Mild, unemphatic approval that takes in habits as well as appearance, where *clean-cut* is a verdict on looks alone.
members._gloss: marked by order and cleanliness in appearance or habits

members.tone: Smartness with a sharp edge to it - the neatness reads as definition of outline, where *trim* praises proportion.
Spruce and compact - the same smartness pulled tight, without *clean-cut*'s sharpness of line.
Here the smartness is one of proportion, nothing loose and nothing spare, where *clean-cut* is about crispness.
The plain word of approval for it - nothing out of place, where *orderly* wants an arrangement behind the tidiness.
Credits the system rather than the surface: things are arranged, not merely unmessy as with *neat*.
A quiet yes to tidiness with no appraisal in it, next to the brisk verdict of *shipshape*.
The briskest approval in the family - order thorough enough that nothing is left to put right, where *neat* is satisfied with the surface.
members._gloss: characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder

members.tone: Praises the keeping as much as the state - the order reads as sustained, where *shipshape* praises how complete it is.
members._gloss: characterized by order and neatness; free from disorder

members.tone: Informal, and the tidiness is put on rather than native - a spruced state, where *well-kept* implies it never lapsed.
The bare arrangement word - things put right, with none of the polish *shipshape* claims.
Approves by subtraction, the merit lying in what is gone, where *neat* and *orderly* credit an arrangement.
Flatter than *uncluttered* - it denies mess rather than paying a compliment for its absence.

families.axis: bare failure to match → outright contradiction
families._definition: displaying a lack of consistency

members.tone: The plain, unemphatic name for the fault - it marks a failure to hold together without saying how sharp the clash is.
Idiomatic and comparatively mild - it frames the disagreement as two things standing opposed rather than as either one being wrong.
Puts the two sides in active collision, stronger than *at odds* but stopping short of claiming they cannot both stand.
The hardest of the disagreement words - it says the two cancel each other, so one of them has to go.
Turns the clash inward so no second party is needed - the thing defeats itself, which is the more damning charge.
Formal and measuring - it registers the mismatch against the facts coolly, where *incompatible* pronounces on it.
States the mismatch as a settled property of the thing rather than an observation about it, blunter and more final than *discrepant*.
Informal and deflating - it breaks the thing into good patches and bad ones, so the complaint carries a grudging concession inside it.
The mildest of these - it registers variation without deciding that any part of the thing has failed.
Informal and slighting - it allows the thing no smooth stretch at all, where *spotty* at least grants good patches between the bad.
Technical and unblaming - it records only that two things fail to correspond and leaves the fault unassigned.
Points at work left undone rather than at a defect - the clash simply stands, not declared unresolvable as *incompatible* would have it.

families.axis: just barely made out → noticeable to the point of intruding
families._definition: capable or worthy of being noticed

members.tone: The plain, unjudged term of the set — it rates a thing as able or worth noticing without saying whether the noticing is welcome, which is exactly what *obtrusive* adds.
members._gloss: capable or worthy of being noticed

members.tone: A speech word: it grades how thickly the regional colouring comes through, not how plainly a thing shows itself.
Near-instrumental in feel — it frames the thing as something a look or a test turns up, where *perceptible* frames it as something the senses take in.
Pitches the same easy visibility at the observer's senses rather than at a search, which is what sets it apart from *detectable*.
The most guarded of the three — it grants only that the thing can be picked out, without *evident*'s suggestion that it announces itself.
members._gloss: capable of being seen or noticed

members.tone: Stronger than *discernible* on the same footing: what is evident presents itself rather than waiting to be made out.
members._gloss: capable of being seen or noticed

members.tone: The flattest of the three — a bare statement that observation is possible, carrying none of *evident*'s force.
members._gloss: capable of being seen or noticed

members.tone: Raises the degree rather than the ease — the thing stands out by how strongly it is set off, not by how little effort finding it takes.
Carries the same heightened degree as *marked*, but with the sense of a quality pushed forward until it cannot be missed.
The one member that judges: it puts the noticing at the top of the scale and calls it unwanted, where *marked* only measures how far the scale runs.
